dataset.protocol: Author-disjoint; original tokenized annotation texts. Supplied-cast mode uses unambiguous proper-name aliases from human labels,never gold pronoun/speaker assignments or gender. Detected-cast mode uses only library-extracted names. Unique-surface names are diagnostic;canonical inventory is scored by unambiguous named-person identity groups,with nominal-only predictions explicitly unassessed. Coreference covers supported personal pronouns with exact original byte ranges. Quotation speaker numeric suffix IDs are a separate annotation namespace;gold speaker canonical names link through exact unique aliases only,otherwise identity is explicitly unassessed with coverage and all-gold lower-bound recall. Legacy quotes use one-to-one normalized content multiset with repeated-content speaker ambiguity unassessed. Checked explicit-only quotes additionally use exact original delimiter boundaries and source-validated UTF8/UTF16 anchors,including repeated content. Pinned model NER is scored separately on contiguous proper-person spans;nominal and nested entity semantics differ from CoNLL/news. No data edits or model training.
dataset.scope: Development-only projection of frozen v4 preparation;no held-out records.

modelModes: default features; no trained models; heuristic person extraction
limits: Independent published human labels,not blinded fresh editorial annotation or proof of all narrative semantics.
Unique proper-name and supported-person-pronoun tasks are narrower than full nested NER/CoNLL coreference.
Supplied cast is an oracle inventory;detected-cast mode measures its separate effect.
Legacy quotation-content multiset metrics are relaxed;checked explicit-only Exact metrics validate boundaries,source anchors and repeated-content speaker identities separately.
Model metadata records the actual supplied weights;confidence values remain uncalibrated rule strengths.
